test_title: RRB NTPC - Graduate 2025 (CBT 2) Mid-Range Full Test - 03
subject: general
question:
Read the given statement and course of action carefully. Assuming everything in the statement to be completely true, decide which of the suggested courses of action (decision to be taken for follow-up action/correction regarding the problem) should be adopted in respect of it?

**Statement:** The number of complaints lodged by patients and their attendants in Hospital-A has increased during the last five years. Patients have to wait for hours before treatment is started as the number of doctors available is not sufficient to treat the increasing number of patients.

**Courses of action:**

I. More doctors should be recruited in the hospital to meet the needs of the increasing number of patients.

II. Patients should be motivated not to report any case of complaint in order to reduce the number of complaints.

options.text: Both actions I and II should be taken.
The only action I should take.
Neither course of action I nor course of action II should be taken.
Only action II should be followed.

solution:
Given:

**Statement:** The number of complaints lodged by patients and their attendants in Hospital-A has increased during the last five years. Patients have to wait for hours before treatment is started as the number of doctors available is not sufficient to treat the increasing number of patients.

**Courses of action:**

I. More doctors should be recruited in the hospital to meet the needs of the increasing number of patients - **True** (Complaints by patients and their attendants have increased during the last five years as patients have to wait for hours before treatment because of the unavailability of doctors.)

II. Patients should be motivated not to report any case of complaint in order to reduce the number of complaints - False (It is not about the complaints, its about the patients lives as they came to the hospital for treatment and its hospital's responsibility that they should have enough doctors so that patient don't have to wait for a long time.)

So, only action I should take.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 2"**.
